# ai-ui

> Lightweight, accessible Astro components for AI reasoning traces, streaming state, and autonomous agent interfaces. Zero React, zero Radix, zero Tailwind.

## Core Documentation & Pages

- [Interactive Component Showcase](https://www.michaelvereb.com/ai-ui): Full live playground with interactive theme customizer and all 18 components.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/michaelvereb/ai-ui): Open source codebase, component templates, and Astro installation guide.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/michaelvereb/ai-ui/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Machine-readable integration rules and specifications for AI coding agents.

## Component Specifications

- [Reasoning](https://www.michaelvereb.com/ai-ui#comp-reasoning): Collapsible thought stream with sequential verification checkmarks.
- [Thinking Bar](https://www.michaelvereb.com/ai-ui#comp-thinking-bar): Autonomous agent thinking indicator with rotating diagnostic descriptions and clean shimmer.
- [Steps](https://www.michaelvereb.com/ai-ui#comp-steps): Technical diagnostic pipeline with copy action, drawer expansion, and execution timings.
- [Tool Execution](https://www.michaelvereb.com/ai-ui#comp-tool): Structured tool call card with JSON input & output payload inspection.
- [Chain of Thought](https://www.michaelvereb.com/ai-ui#comp-chain-of-thought): Visual reasoning graph with continuous connecting lines between nodes.
- [Prompt Input](https://www.michaelvereb.com/ai-ui#comp-prompt-input): Multiline AI prompt container with model badge, attachment actions, and submit trigger.
- [Model Selector](https://www.michaelvereb.com/ai-ui#comp-model-selector): Dropdown menu for selecting orchestrator models with provider metadata.
- [Suggestions](https://www.michaelvereb.com/ai-ui#comp-suggestions): One-click query chips for autonomous audits and common workflows.
- [Questions](https://www.michaelvereb.com/ai-ui#comp-questions): Interactive clarification card with selectable option pills and radio controls.
- [Feedback Bar](https://www.michaelvereb.com/ai-ui#comp-feedback-bar): Response satisfaction rating with copy and report triggers.
- [Attachments](https://www.michaelvereb.com/ai-ui#comp-attachments): File chips with byte size indicator and dismiss action.
- [Citation](https://www.michaelvereb.com/ai-ui#comp-citation): Numbered external reference badge with live domain favicons.
- [Message & Thread](https://www.michaelvereb.com/ai-ui#comp-thread): Message bubble and full conversation wrappers for streaming sessions.
- [Loader](https://www.michaelvereb.com/ai-ui#comp-loader): Agent execution states (spinner, dots, pulse, and progress bar).
- [Text Shimmer](https://www.michaelvereb.com/ai-ui#comp-text-shimmer): Animated gradient sweep signaling active LLM token streaming.
- [Theme Customizer](https://www.michaelvereb.com/ai-ui): Live slide-out drawer for adjusting mode, base colors, SF Pro typography, and radii.
- [Text Animations](https://www.michaelvereb.com/ai-ui#comp-text-animations): 20 Web Animations API (WAAPI) and CSS text effects.
